title: Breakthrough with Healing Chronic Pain | Howard Schubiner | Talks at Google
summary: Dr. Howard Schubiner presents his research that much chronic pain comes from learned neural pathways rather than structural damage, and outlines a treatment approach based on that view.
why: Recommended to people with chronic pain, fatigue or RSI as a rigorous but balanced case that pain does not always mean injury.

quote.text: The author links to Schubiner's talk on chronic pain, which I heartily recommend as the right balance of rigor and tone
